messages.subject: Problem with the installation
messages.body_plain: Hi, I was trying to install Deducer in my new computer, and when I click on "Download Installer" in http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/index.php?n=Main.WindowsInstallation, it brings me to a page with  "Hard-to-Reach Population Methods Research Group" as a title, with no references to the installation of the program. Does anybody know why?? I've tried installing it from R but haven't achieved it either. Thank you!!
